task: Implement route_request for the service mesh without using API gateway routing logic.

candidate_memories.content: Service mesh route_request selects an upstream instance based on load, latency, and health checks.
Mesh routing is dynamic; instance selection happens at request time using real-time health data.
Mesh routing decisions are made by the sidecar proxy, not by application-level code.
When route_request spans mesh and gateway layers, confirm which layer owns the routing decision.
API gateway: route_request maps URL prefixes to upstream services using a static route table.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: static URL-prefix routing is incompatible with dynamic mesh health-based routing

candidate_memories.content: Old infra note says routing logic should be consolidated at the API gateway layer eventually.
